body.x: LG Electronics(www.lg.co.kr) introduced up-to-date TVs, homechat, smartphone, and appliances at 'Press Conference' of the CES 2014, the biggest IT∙appliances show held in Las Vegas, U.S. from January 7th to 10th.

There are 'ULTRA HDTV lineup', which featured a massive 105-inch screen with a 21:9 aspect ratio and 5120 x 2160 5K resolution, and LG 'Homechat', which is a way to communicate with your devices. LG is also demonstrating its new 'G Flex' 6-inch smart phone, and Fitness Tech, such as 'Lifeband Touch' and 'Heart Rate Earphones'. Also, there are many home appliances, for example, audios, speakers, washing machines, and refrigerators.

'CES 2014(The International Consumer Electronics Show)' is owned and produced by the Consumer Electronics Association (CEA), the technology trade association. CES showcases 2,500 ~ 3,200 exhibitors in every kind of electronic appliance. More than 152,000 attendees from more than 150 countries come to the show.
